name: Poulan 2150 / 3816
blurb: Common big-box homeowner saws. Oregon lists both for its 91-series chain: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links.
intro: The Poulan 2150 and 3816 are among the most common budget homeowner saws in US garages, and they appear by name in Oregon's fitment data for its 91-series low-profile chain. McCulloch saws of the same era were built on related platforms, but because we have not traced per-model McCulloch fitments to a citable source, this page covers the Poulan models Oregon names — and points McCulloch owners at the bar stamp, which settles any of these saws in a minute.

sources.title: Product data for 91VXL056G / S56 (3/8″ Low Profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links; fitments include Poulan 2150 and 3816)

sources_note: Oregon product data for 91VXL056G / S56 (3/8″ Low Profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links; fitments include Poulan 2150 and 3816) — checked Oct 2026.

bars.note: Oregon lists the Poulan 2150 and 3816 among the fitments for this exact chain. Many of these saws have had bars swapped over the years — the stamp check is not optional on a 15-year-old saw.
